youtube.title: This photo is black & white… but you’ll see color 🤯 #shorts
youtube.description:
Stare at the red dot for 15 seconds without blinking. Then the black & white photo looks colorful – your eyes adapt to the inverted colors (a negative afterimage).

Did it work for you? 👇

#illusion #opticalillusion #brain
